हासिनी

HĀSINĪ . An apsarā woman of Alakāpurī. She once danced in Kubera's assembly to welcome sage aṣṭāvakra (anuśāsana parva, Chapter 19, Verse 45).

हस्तामलक

HASTĀMALAKA . A disciple of Śrī śaṅkara. (See under śaṅkarācārya, para 7).

हस्ति १

HASTI I . A King born in the lunar dynasty. (Ādi Parva, Chapter 94 Verse 58).

हस्ति २

HASTI II . Another king of the lunar dynasty. His father was suhotra and mother suvarṇā, who belonged to the ikṣvāku dynasty. This hasti married yaśodharā, daughter of King trigarta, and a son called Vikaṇṭha was born to them. hastināpura was the city newly built by hasti. (Ādi Parva Chapter 95, Verse 34).

हस्तिभद्र

HASTIBHADRA . A nāga born in the kaśyapa dynasty. (Udyoga Parva, Chapter 103, Verse 13).

हस्तिकश्यप

HASTIKAŚYAPA . A great sage who lived in North india in very olden days. He once met and talked with śrī kṛṣṇa, who was doing tapas on the mountains. (anuśāsana parva, Chapter 139, Verse 11).

हस्तिनापुर

HASTINĀPURA . Capital city of the pāṇḍavas. (See under hasti II).

हस्तिपद

HASTIPADA . A nāga born in the kaśyapa dynasty. (Ādi Parva, Chapter 35 Verse 9).

हस्तिपिण्ड

HASTIPIṆḌA . A nāga born in the kaśyapa dynasty (Ādi Parva, Chapter 35, Verse 14).

हस्तिसोमा

HASTISOMĀ . A famous river mentioned frequently in the Purāṇas. (bhīṣma parva, Chapter 9, Verse 19)
